# components/diff

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/diff/diff.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { diffLines, DiffView } from "@tundralibs/ui/diff"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/diff.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `diffLines`

```ts
diffLines(before: string, after: string): DiffLine[]
```

A line diff of two short texts — a config file, a template, a note —
for the server to compute and {@link DiffView} to draw. Plain
longest-common-subsequence over lines, deterministic, no heuristics;
it is O(n·m) in memory, so keep it to texts of a few hundred lines and
use a real diff engine beyond that. Unchanged lines come back as
`context` with both numbers.

### `DiffView`

```ts
DiffView(props: DiffViewProps): Html
```

A line diff as a table: number gutters, `+` / `−` markers drawn by CSS
(so a copied selection is the text alone), added and removed lines on
the status tones, hunk headers muted. `unified` is one column of
changes, `split` is old beside new with removed and added runs paired
row by row. Rendered by the server from {@link DiffLine}s —
{@link diffLines} makes them from two strings.

## Types

### `DiffLineType`

A line's part in the change: added, removed, unchanged context, or a hunk header.

- `"add"`
- `"remove"`
- `"context"`
- `"meta"`

### `DiffLine`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `DiffLineType` | yes |  |
| `text` | `string` | yes | The line's text, without its newline. |
| `oldNo` | `number` |  | Line number in the old text (context and removed lines). |
| `newNo` | `number` |  | Line number in the new text (context and added lines). |

### `DiffViewMode`

One column of changes (`unified`) or old beside new (`split`).

- `"unified"`
- `"split"`

### `DiffViewSize`

How tall the view may grow before it scrolls inside itself: 12 / 20 / 32 rem.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `DiffViewProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `lines` | `DiffLine[]` | yes | The lines, in order — from {@link diffLines} or a parsed patch. |
| `view` | `DiffViewMode` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  | The file's path, shown in the header. |
| `stats` | `boolean` |  | Show `+N −M` in the header. @default true |
| `wrap` | `boolean` |  | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways. |
| `maxHeight` | `DiffViewSize` |  | Cap the height; the view scrolls inside itself past it. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### What changed in a config file

`diffLines` is a plain line LCS for short texts; feed `DiffView` a real engine's output beyond a few hundred lines.

```ts
DiffView({
  title: "deno.json",
  lines: diffLines(
    '{\n  "version": "0.23.0",\n  "private": false\n}',
    '{\n  "version": "0.24.0",\n  "private": false,\n  "sideEffects": false\n}',
  ),
})
```

```html
<div class="diff diff--unified" data-diff>
  <div class="diff__header">
    <span class="diff__title">deno.json</span>
    <span class="diff__stats">
      <span class="diff__stat diff__stat--add">+3</span>
      <span class="diff__stat diff__stat--remove">&minus;2</span>
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="diff__scroll">
    <table class="diff__table">
      <tbody>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--context">
          <td class="diff__no">1</td>
          <td class="diff__no">1</td>
          <td class="diff__text">{</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--add">
          <td class="diff__no"></td>
          <td class="diff__no">2</td>
          <td class="diff__text">&quot;version&quot;: &quot;0.24.0&quot;,</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--add">
          <td class="diff__no"></td>
          <td class="diff__no">3</td>
          <td class="diff__text">&quot;private&quot;: false,</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--add">
          <td class="diff__no"></td>
          <td class="diff__no">4</td>
          <td class="diff__text">&quot;sideEffects&quot;: false</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--remove">
          <td class="diff__no">2</td>
          <td class="diff__no"></td>
          <td class="diff__text">&quot;version&quot;: &quot;0.23.0&quot;,</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--remove">
          <td class="diff__no">3</td>
          <td class="diff__no"></td>
          <td class="diff__text">&quot;private&quot;: false</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--context">
          <td class="diff__no">4</td>
          <td class="diff__no">5</td>
          <td class="diff__text">}</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Old beside new

```ts
DiffView({
  view: "split",
  maxHeight: "md",
  lines: [
    { type: "meta", text: "@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@" },
    { type: "context", text: ".btn {", oldNo: 1, newNo: 1 },
    { type: "remove", text: "  padding: 6px 12px;", oldNo: 2 },
    { type: "add", text: "  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);", newNo: 2 },
    { type: "context", text: "}", oldNo: 3, newNo: 3 },
  ],
})
```

```html
<div class="diff diff--split diff--md" data-diff>
  <div class="diff__header">
    <span class="diff__stats">
      <span class="diff__stat diff__stat--add">+1</span>
      <span class="diff__stat diff__stat--remove">&minus;1</span>
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="diff__scroll" tabindex="0">
    <table class="diff__table">
      <tbody>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--meta">
          <td class="diff__text" colspan="4">@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--context">
          <td class="diff__no diff__no--context">1</td>
          <td class="diff__text diff__text--context">.btn {</td>
          <td class="diff__no diff__no--context">1</td>
          <td class="diff__text diff__text--context">.btn {</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--change">
          <td class="diff__no diff__no--remove">2</td>
          <td class="diff__text diff__text--remove">padding: 6px 12px;</td>
          <td class="diff__no diff__no--add">2</td>
          <td class="diff__text diff__text--add">padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="diff__line diff__line--context">
          <td class="diff__no diff__no--context">3</td>
          <td class="diff__text diff__text--context">}</td>
          <td class="diff__no diff__no--context">3</td>
          <td class="diff__text diff__text--context">}</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>
```
